title: Evidence behind vetting passes was not stored in the repository
what_happened: Registry ledger entries recorded tier and check status, but the per-check notes, metrics, consumed manifest IDs / SHA-256 values / query URLs and images that supported each pass lived only under the git-ignored runs/ and dossiers/ directories. A pass row in the ledger could therefore not be checked from a clone of the repository. The registrations made before the evidence store (including 5628404318169472) remain without committed evidence and are reported as legacy_without_evidence.
generic_lesson: Every registration commits a compact, size-guarded evidence directory (registry/evidence/<source_id>/<run_id>/) with an index of file SHA-256 values, and the ledger entry references the directory and the index SHA-256. CI verifies the hashes and that every pass/fail row has its evidence file; entries without evidence are counted, not hidden.
